title: Production Accepted-State Operator & Bounded Stiffness-Aware Indicator Seam
scope: smallest production solver-owned service that materializes the qualified F-SI24/F-VQ30 bounded stiffness-aware temporal indicator without exposing HeadCalc internals and without admitting temporal acceptance policy

public_contract_direction.service: soil-water-solver-owned temporal-indicator evaluation after a converged candidate solve
public_contract_direction.input_history: previous accepted right-sided pressure-head derivative is supplied explicitly by the transaction/runtime owner; F-SI25 does not persist it
public_contract_direction.current_derivative: computed from candidate pressure head, base pressure head and generic step_duration
public_contract_direction.output: availability/status, B_inf and supporting bounded diagnostics plus current right-sided derivative for prospective downstream commit
public_contract_direction.unavailable_default: generic soil-water solvers may return not-available without changing solve semantics
public_contract_direction.reference_solver_override: reference Richards solver evaluates its own accepted-state operator internally and performs at most one additional tridiagonal defect solve

qualified_initial_implementation_envelop.operator_policy_semantics: for SwKimpl=0 preserve current HeadCalc policy: Darcy conductivities/means are frozen from the base-state time level while storage capacity is evaluated at the converged candidate state; bottom prescribed-head contribution is included
qualified_initial_implementation_envelop.unsupported_routes: fail closed as indicator unavailable; principal solve remains unchanged

state_and_scratch_ownership.future_optional_persistent_state_owner: F-KT/runtime transaction layer after separate composition qualification
state_and_scratch_ownership.future_optional_persistent_state: previous accepted right-sided derivative plus continuity-valid metadata only when indicator/policy is active

hard_guards: No HeadCalc private array is exposed, retained or read by runtime, crop, coupler or process modules.
Do not reuse the final Newton workspace dfdh arrays as if they were the exact accepted-state operator.
No extra full nonlinear Richards solve is allowed for the indicator normal path.
At most one extra tridiagonal defect solve is allowed.
No N4/N8/N128/N256/N512 refinement ladder is allowed in production code.
No safety factor, global multiplier, material coefficient, state normalization, floor inflation or temporal tolerance may be fitted.
Indicator evaluation cannot alter candidate state, accepted fluxes, mass accounting, retry advice or principal solve status.
No calendar/day boundary assumption may be introduced.
No F-GC02, F-PE or retry-policy release follows from F-SI25 implementation alone.

gates.A_contract_and_lineage: This contract is persisted before production source changes and locks F-SI24/F-VQ30 semantics.
gates.B_generic_solver_service: Introduce a common soil-water solver temporal-indicator result/service with a fail-closed default unavailable implementation so alternative solvers are not forced to expose Richards internals.
gates.C_reference_richards_operator: Implement the reference Richards override inside the solver boundary for the qualified initial envelope and reconstruct the current-policy accepted-state operator without reading stale final Newton arrays.
gates.D_candidate_semantics: Compute exactly the frozen e_raw, one defect solve, B_M and B_inf; return current derivative but do not persist history or choose acceptance tolerance.
gates.E_noninterference_and_cost: Focused tests prove principal candidate state/flux/mass/status identity with indicator disabled versus evaluated and prove zero extra nonlinear solves and at most one extra tridiagonal solve.
gates.F_owner_replay: Replay the exact-linear formula regression and the frozen 16-case F-VQ30 matrix against the production seam as owner verification; this is not a substitute for downstream independent F-VQ31 qualification.
gates.G_O0_O2: Machine-readable owner test outputs are bitwise identical under current convention.

hard_nonclaims: B_inf is not a qualified general nonlinear true-error bound.
No scientific temporal tolerance is selected.
No production acceptance/retry policy is admitted.
F-VQ28 and F-VQ29 negative evidence remains valid.
next_action: Implement Gate B first with the smallest generic solver-owned temporal-indicator contract and default unavailable behavior, then add the reference Richards override and focused owner tests.
